# LTC Appoints Real Estate Capital Markets Veteran Eric Clark as Senior Vice President, Corporate Finance and Investor Relations


November 02, 2026 9:15 am EST[Download as PDF](https://ir.ltcreit.com/_assets/_60ca1eb44241af1f6cbeb494ea23bafc/ltcreit/news/2026-11-02_LTC_Appoints_Real_Estate_Capital_Markets_Veteran_477.pdf)


WESTLAKE VILLAGE, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- **LTC Properties, Inc. (NYSE: LTC)** (“LTC” or the “Company”), a real estate investment trust specializing in seniors housing and health care properties, today announced the appointment of Eric Clark as Senior Vice President, Corporate Finance and Investor Relations, a new position at the Company. Mr. Clark will lead and manage LTC’s capital markets, financial forecasting and investor relations functions. He will work closely with executive leadership to engage institutional investors, sell-side analysts and rating agencies to support the Company’s continued growth.


This press release features multimedia. View the full release here:[https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261102258231/en/](https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261102258231/en/)


Eric Clark, Senior Vice President, Corporate Finance and Investor Relations


Mr. Clark joins LTC from BTIG, where he served as Managing Director, Investment Banking focused on capital markets and mergers and acquisitions; his coverage included approximately 60 public REITs across all property types. He brings more than 14 years of real estate investment banking and capital markets experience spanning public and private real estate. Prior to BTIG, Mr. Clark held similar positions with Citizens JMP Securities and Wunderlich Securities. Mr. Clark holds a Bachelor of Science in Business Administration from Bryant University.


“Eric brings a solid combination of capital markets expertise, strategic insight, and deep knowledge of the real estate industry,” said Cece Chikhale, LTC’s Chief Financial Officer. “His appointment comes as LTC is building significant momentum through the continued growth of our seniors housing operating portfolio (“SHOP”). We believe Eric will be a valuable addition to our team as we execute on our growth strategy, deepen engagement with the investment community, and pursue ongoing opportunities to create sustainable long-term shareholder value.”


“LTC’s transformation to a SHOP-focused REIT has accelerated its external growth capabilities and positions the Company with a higher intrinsic growth profile,” said Clark. "This growth, along with a strong balance sheet and disciplined approach to capital allocation, creates a compelling opportunity. I look forward to leveraging my experience to help support LTC’s growth objectives and communicate the Company’s story to a wider audience.”


**About LTC**


LTC is a real estate investment trust (REIT) focused on seniors housing and health care properties, principally investing through SHOP, as well as triple-net leases, and joint ventures. The Company’s portfolio includes nearly 170 properties throughout the United States. Based on gross real estate investments, 80% of the Company’s assets are seniors housing communities with the remainder skilled nursing centers. Learn more at[www.ltcreit.com](https://www.ltcreit.com/) .
